traditional: A soft contact. Love, money, and pleasure supports limitation, delay, and hard structure - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Saturn.
modern: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. The trine makes this a natural strength: Committed, steady, and loyal in relationships and finances. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Connection and limit flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what connection and limit have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.summary: Capital finally unlocks for a plan that has been sitting on hold.
readerCopy.body: Capital finally unlocks for a plan that has been sitting on hold. The budget gets approved, schedules line up, or reservations are confirmed once the full cost is on paper. Venus keeps the result desirable and worth protecting, while Saturn checks the price, deadline, responsibility, and work required to maintain it. Under the trine, value and commitment support each other without making pleasure feel irresponsible. The agreement can last because the cost was named before anyone moved forward.
